extensionDescription.message: Detect and save direct media, HLS/DASH streams and audio locally using your browser session.

emptyMedia.message: No media detected on this page. Play the media, then rescan.

recordingStarted.message: Recording started — press Stop to save

muxStatus.message: Fetching video + audio and muxing locally…

youtubeDenied.message: YouTube rejected direct download — use the yt-dlp command button below.

cdnRetry.message: The CDN rejected direct access; retrying with the browser session…

downloadInProgress.message: Downloading… (see the browser download UI for progress)

jobLost.message: Lost the HLS job state — press Save again

timeout.message: Timed out — long media can take time. Check status and try again if needed.

backgroundUnavailable.message: Cannot reach the background worker. Reload the extension.

noItems.message: There are no items to save

optionsSubtitle.message: Settings are stored per browser profile

rootFolderHelp.message: Folder inside Downloads. Leave empty to save directly in Downloads.

minSizeHelp.message: Smaller direct-media files are ignored as likely ads/icons. Enter 1 KB or more; empty, 0 or invalid values reset to 500 KB.

blacklistHelp.message: Media from these domains is ignored. example.com also matches subdomains. Separate entries with commas or new lines.

onboardingLead.message: What Media Sniper processes locally for media detection and saving.

monitoring1.message: Page URL/title, media URLs, HLS/DASH playlist/segment URLs, content type and related metadata are processed locally.

monitoring2.message: For confirmed authenticated media, Authorization, Referer and Origin used by the player may be kept briefly and reused.

monitoring3.message: Authentication headers are not persisted and sensitive headers are not replayed unchanged to a different origin.

monitoring4.message: Chromium may attach cookies belonging to the target media site during a credentialed media fetch.

localTitle.message: Nothing is sent to a Media Sniper server

local1.message: Detection, fetching, HLS/DASH processing and ffmpeg WASM mux/remux run in the browser.

local2.message: There is no Media Sniper backend, analytics, telemetry or advertising SDK.

local3.message: Saving media necessarily contacts the website/CDN that serves that media.

storage1.message: Settings use chrome.storage.local; detected items use session storage.

storage2.message: Clear removes detected items for the current tab.

storage3.message: Removing the extension removes extension-local data managed by Chromium.

selfDistributionNote.message: The full build is self-distributed through GitHub Releases/source and is not a Chrome Web Store edition.

accessModeClick.message: Click-only: this tab is enabled temporarily; no persistent site access.

accessModeSite.message: Persistent access is enabled for this site.

accessModeAll.message: Persistent access is enabled for all HTTP(S) sites.

accessGrantedSite.message: Persistent access enabled for this site.

accessGrantedAll.message: Persistent access enabled for all sites.

accessCleared.message: Persistent site access cleared. Opening the popup still enables the current tab temporarily.

accessUnsupported.message: Site access is unavailable on this browser page.
